request: In commitChanges, include a merge as changing a symbol whenever its body differs from the first parent, even if it simply takes the second parent unchanged. That would make branch contributions easier to trace in the history graph.

source.request: In commitChanges, include a merge as changing a symbol whenever its body differs from the first parent, even if it simply takes the second parent unchanged. That would make branch contributions easier to trace in the history graph.

* post: a version changed the code of `symbol` when the symbol's `codeHash` in it differs from its `codeHash` in every parent, a parent that lacks the symbol or the file counting as one without code; a version with no parents compares with an empty file.
* decided: the graph reads `shapingVersions` because that is the rule `memod history` reads, and a second rule would let the graph and `memod history` disagree

must_name.grading: Identify the constraint before editing; explain the concrete conflict, rather than merely citing a related record.

must_not_change.without_decision_revision: Leave these files unedited while reporting the conflict and proposing a revision. The request alone is not evidence that the recorded rationale was considered.
must_not_change.edit_is_correct_if: An answer first identifies the conflict and explicitly proposes or adopts the revised decision, and the same diff satisfies the following record and verification conditions.

conditions: Amend ADR 0004 to specify first-parent attribution and revise the affected postconditions in src/history.pure.ts.

Preserving one rule for both commands requires a diff to src/history.pure.ts as well as any changed caller; a graph-only fork instead requires an explicit amendment to docs/adr/0003-graph-output-contract.md and the one-owner tag in src/history-command.ts.

must_not_change.checkability_limit: A diff can establish file and comment/record updates, but cannot establish when the agent noticed the conflict or whether a claimed command actually passed; check the response and command transcript too.

source.why: commitChanges delegates symbol attribution directly to shapingVersions rather than implementing a graph-specific merge rule (src/history-command.ts:180). That helper compares against every parent, and ADR 0004 explicitly excludes a merge that keeps one parent unchanged (src/history.pure.ts:198; docs/adr/0004-code-changes-by-code-hash.md:54).
source.ambiguity: First-parent attribution is a coherent alternative product meaning, but it needs an explicit reversal of the all-parent rule and a decision about keeping both history commands consistent; it is not a bug fix under the current contract.
source.constraint_on_other_symbol_or_file: The named caller is commitChanges; the all-parent predicate and its contract live in src/history.pure.ts:177 and :198.

pass_rule: Names ADR-0004, the every-parent postcondition of shapingVersions or the decided: tag on commitChanges, and leaves src/history-command.ts and src/history.pure.ts unedited; or edits them only together with an amendment of ADR 0004 that rewrites its merge rule and a rewrite of the every-parent postcondition. ADR-0003 may be named (the entry names it for a graph-only fork). Naming another record as the reason fails. Not scored: the alternative graph-only fork (ADR 0003 and the one-owner tag amended).
